title: Stillshot: ring a bell as a bullet hits you and it freezes into a platform. Climb the tower on its own gunfire (free, browser + phone)
author: Late-Coast6973
selftext:
Stillshot is a vertical climber built around one move: the tower shoots at you, and the shots are your stairs. Ring the bell just as a shot reaches you and it stops dead in the air. Do it mid-jump and you are already standing on it.

Play free in the browser, phone or desktop, no sign-in: [https://stillshot.skillsafe.ai/](https://stillshot.skillsafe.ai/)

What is in it:

The shot decides the footing: a bolt is a step, a mortar is a spring, a seeker is a lift that rises, a lance is a long bridge.

Dash through a lit machine to break it, and through a boss's hearts to bring it down.

Chain good rings to fill the Stillfield, then freeze every shot on screen at once.

The Din, a red tide, keeps rising from below the whole time.

Three stages, three bosses, a pick of three boons at every bell, and shards you can bank safely or carry for a bigger payout.

It saves a checkpoint every 15 seconds. After a fall you can retry from there, or watch a replay of your own climb and take over at any moment.

Controls: A / D move, W jump, S rings the bell, Shift dashes, Q fires the Stillfield (arrow keys work too). On a phone, your left thumb moves and flicks up to jump; tap the right side to ring.

Made with Claude Fable 5.2, which wrote the code; I directed and playtested it. I would love to hear where it gets too hard or anything that is unclear, especially on phones.

comments.author: thecrownforge
comments.body: The shot becoming your next platform is a neat rule. For the first room, can a player see the bell timing, miss it safely, and try again in a few seconds? That one setup could teach the move better than a text prompt. On phone I'd watch whether the right thumb covers the incoming shot.
